comparison.objective: Progressively seat a fixed-end power cord along an entire curved channel.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential deformable routing and pressing along a bend without pulling out the anchored end.
comparison.success_condition: All eight channel sections contain the cord below the lip; channel and source box remain fixed.
comparison.reason: Progressive cable routing is meaningfully different from fine-tool engagement, locking, and quantitative damper tuning.
